REPORT_PANELS.DESCRIPTION: Saved report panels for this account: metrics, charts, and tables with optional filters.
REPORT_PANELS.EMPTY: No panels yet. Create one to track the metrics you care about.

LIST.SCOPE_HINT: Metric widgets count the whole account for the date range (all statuses, including unassigned). Agent summary tables break down by assignee and include an “Unassigned” row. Use panel filters (e.g. status = open/pending) to narrow every widget.

REPORT_PANELS.TABLE_CLICK_HINT: Click a row to open the conversation or contact.

FIELDS.NAME: Name
FIELDS.DATE_ATTRIBUTE_HINT: Use a conversation date/datetime custom attribute (e.g. sale date) instead of created date for the panel period.
FIELDS.AGGREGATION_FIELD_OPTIONAL_HINT: Leave empty to count matching rows, or pick any attribute to count only rows where it is set (non-empty).
FIELDS.AGGREGATION_GROUP_FIELD_HINT: Use a custom date or date-time attribute (e.g. sale date) for the X-axis and period filter. Leave empty to use conversation/contact created date. Pair with a numeric custom attribute above (e.g. price) for sales charts.
FIELDS.TABLE_COLUMNS_HINT: Choose columns to show. On summary tables, use the pivot builder (Fields → Rows / Columns / Values). Changing the table type resets columns.
FIELDS.TABLE_COLUMNS_HINT_DETAIL: Search and pick columns to show. Changing the table type resets columns.

PIVOT.ROWS_HINT: Like Excel Rows: agent, inbox, team, or label summary — one row per entity.
PIVOT.COLUMNS_HINT: Like Excel Columns: pick one conversation list/text attribute (e.g. stage). Its values become column groups. Leave empty for a flat summary (no pivot).
PIVOT.COLUMN_VALUES_HINT: Unchecked values are hidden. Leave all checked (or none stored) to show every value found.
PIVOT.COLUMN_VALUES_AUTO: No fixed list on this attribute — segments are discovered from data (max 12).
PIVOT.VALUES_HINT: Like Excel Values: measures to aggregate. With a pivot field set, each measure expands once per column value (e.g. sale · Conversations, support · Conversations).
PIVOT.VALUES_EMPTY: Drag a field here, or add a measure below.
PIVOT.FIELDS_HINT: Drag to Columns or Values, or use the shortcuts on hover.
PIVOT.FIELDS_CONTACT_HINT: Contact values are stored on the contact (formulas are lifetime totals). For period sums use conversation attributes.
PIVOT.ZONE_ROWS_HINT: Fixed by table type — change Rows above to switch entity.

FILTERS.TITLE: Report filters
FILTERS.HINT: Like Excel filters / slicers: apply to the whole panel (outer AND), including metrics and pivot tables. Conversation filters narrow conversations (try status = open/pending/resolved); contact filters intersect contacts. Pivot Columns still break down within this filtered set. Max 10.
FILTERS.MIXED_GROUPS_BANNER: Conversation and contact filters are combined with AND across groups. OR only applies within the same group (all conversation conditions, or all contact conditions).
FILTERS.EMPTY: No filters. Metrics count the whole account for the date range; agent tables show assigned agents plus Unassigned.

ERRORS.CUSTOM_RANGE_REQUIRED: Pick a custom start and end date
